layers.authority: Lào Cai Provincial People's Council (Resolution 05/2024/NQ-HĐND, reported by the provincial newspaper)
layers.process: The provincial council set a sightseeing fee for the Fansipan summit area and the Cát Cát waterfall in Sa Pa: 10,000 dong per person per entry for visitors aged 16 and over, 5,000 dong for under 16. The fee applies to all visitors. The figures come from a newspaper report of the resolution, not the resolution text, so they need checking against the resolution. Cable car tickets and guided treks are separate; no permit rules for treks were found.

sources.authority: Báo Lào Cai (Lào Cai provincial Party newspaper)

laws.rule: Independent (self-arranged) hiking to Fansipan on foot in Hoang Lien National Park requires a guide who has been trained in forest protection, forest-fire prevention and biodiversity, and who holds a forest entry card issued by the park. Visitors must register with the park's Tourism and Biodiversity Conservation Centre for a forest entry permit (Giấy phép ra vào rừng), stay on the registered route and rest only at the points listed in the permit, and buy a visit ticket and insurance. Official trailheads are Tram Ton, Sin Chai village and Cat Cat village. Combining the cable car with a trek still requires those park procedures. The official FAQ does not state the ticket price in this pass.
